paper_title: RedWhale An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining
caption: : Financial QA-2 evaluation.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the evaluation results of two language models, EVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 and Red Whale (our), on the Financial QA-2 dataset. The horizontal axis represents the two models, with “EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0” appearing before “Red Whale (our)”. The vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy” and spans from 0 to 100, with tick labels incrementing by 10. Each model is represented by a stacked bar, with each segment of the bar denoting a different accuracy level; a legend at the bottom of the chart identifies the segments as "Correct", "Partially Correct", and "Incorrect", colored purple, light blue, and pale blue, respectively. For EVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, the “Correct” segment has a value of 92.9, the "Partially Correct" segment has a value of 2.9, and the "Incorrect" segment has a value of 4.3. For Red Whale (our), the "Correct" segment extends to a value of 95.7, the “Partially Correct” segment to 1.4, and the "Incorrect" section to 2.9. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
